en.headline: Government opens three-month consultation on food sweetener rules
en.dek: Proposed changes would bring sugar alcohols under the law, expand the permitted list from 10 to 21 additives and set maximum levels for specific food pairings.
body: The government has opened a three-month public consultation on proposed amendments to the Sweeteners in Food Regulations, the Environment and Ecology Bureau and the Centre for Food Safety said.

The draft package would bring polyhydric alcohols, also known as sugar alcohols and already common in chewing gum and reduced-sugar products, within the scope of the regulations. It would also expand the permitted list from the current 10 sweeteners to 21, including advantame and ten polyhydric alcohols covered by the Codex Alimentarius General Standard for Food Additives, and introduce maximum permitted levels for particular sweetener-and-food combinations.

A government spokesman said the changes were intended to protect public health and align Hong Kong’s standards with Codex, the Chinese mainland and major trading partners. The Centre for Food Safety said it had carried out about 900 sweetener tests on local market samples, with about 98 per cent meeting the proposed limits.

The Expert Committee on Food Safety has supported the proposals, and lawmakers on the Panel on Food Safety and Environmental Hygiene were briefed in June. After the subsidiary legislation is passed, the government proposes an 18-month transitional period so the trade can adapt. Views are being invited from the public and the industry.

zh.headline: 政府就食物甜味劑規例展開三個月公眾諮詢
zh.dek: 建議將多美醇納入規管、准用名單由10種增至21種，並按食物與甜味劑組合訂最高含量，完成立法後擬設18個月過渡期。
body: 環境及生態局與食物環境衞生署食物安全中心宣布，即日起就修訂《食物內甜味劑規例》展開為期三個月的公眾諮詢，邀請市民及業界提交意見。
修例方向包括將多美醇（又稱糖醇，常用於香口膠及減糖食品）納入規管範圈；把准許甜味劑名單由現時10種擴大至21種，當中包括食品法典委員會《食品添加劑通用標準》涵蓋的10種多美醇及advantame；以及按不同食物與甜味劑組合訂定最高准許含量。
政府發言人表示，修訂旨在更有效保障公眾健康，並與食品法典委員會、內地及主要食品貿易伙伴的標準接軌。食安中心從市面抽取食物樣本進行約900項甜味劑測試，約98%符合建議的最高准許含量。
有關建議已獲食物安全專家委員會支持，當局亦於6月向立法會食物安全及環境衞生事務委員會簡介。完成附屬法例立法程序後，政府建議設18個月過渡期，讓業界適應新規定。
